name: Abbie's World cutscene rubric
source_enum_note: source values are the identity schema's enum (docs/oracle/identity/game-identity.schema.json): footage_cv = computer vision over our own captures, llm_judge = VLM with saved prompt, pairwise and both orders, playtrace = in-game log, human = Evan or a child playtest, estimate = not yet measured.

jobs.story: tells something the player could not enact
jobs.reward: celebrates what the player did and makes the prize feel big
jobs.pacing: a breath between efforts, a change of rhythm
jobs.tutorial: shows a new thing working once before the player tries it
jobs.cover: hides loading, streaming, shader compilation or world generation
jobs.bridge: moves the player across place, time or mode without a menu

styles.cinematic: film language: lenses, letterbox, scored music, title cards
styles.storybook: a narrator reads to a child: pages, big gentle words, few cuts
styles.comic: the scene splits into panels, balloons and lettered sound effects
styles.telltale: dialogue drama: speaker lines, choices, 'will remember that', episode cards
styles.diorama: a high three-quarter camera that pulls back to show the whole set as a toy
styles.puppet: in-engine actors on the game's own camera and look; the HUD tucks away

information_modes.diegetic: it happens in the world and characters react; the simulation records it
information_modes.spatial: the camera visits a thing to show only the player
information_modes.meta: a feeling on the lens: slow motion, warm vignette, heartbeat
information_modes.overlay: title cards, chapter numbers, subtitles, letterbox, recap pages
information_modes.none: no cutscene: the world behaves and the player happens to see it

targets.bar_note: Music Bible: D major, ~124 bpm, 3+3+2 eighths = four quarter-note beats per bar = 60/124*4 s.
targets.read_aloud_note: A grown-up reading to a child runs about 130 to 160 words a minute; 2.6 words/s is the ceiling, 2.0 the comfortable middle (estimate).

gates.title: Every cutscene declares a job and a category
gates.method: manifest: jobs non-empty and in taxonomy.jobs; category in taxonomy.categories

gates.title: Pause, seen-once skip, hold to skip, and a tap always answers
gates.method: manifest skip.pause, skip.seen_skip, skip.hold_to_skip, skip.tap_answers all true (covers still loading may set seen_skip false)

gates.title: Every word on screen is read aloud, or there are none
gates.method: words_on_screen == 0 or read_aloud true; with --overlays, words/s per card under read_aloud_wps_max

gates.title: No fade to white, blur or haze; letterbox only where allowed
gates.method: masks has none of banned_masks; letterbox only for allowed styles and not banned categories

gates.title: Length sits in the category band; covers end when ready, within a bar
gates.method: first_s and repeat_s inside length_bands_s; loading_cover cover.ends in (on_ready, on_ready_bar) and settle_bars <= cover_settle_bars_max

gates.title: World events are recorded; presentation is invisible to perception; no engine artifacts
gates.method: recorded true when world_events non-empty; presentation_perceivable false; engine_artifacts false

gates.title: No fail state, no horror sting, no fast flashing, no choice timer for children
gates.method: fail_state false; horror_sting false; flash_hz <= flash_hz_max; audience child implies choice_timer_s null

scored.title: Starts late, ends early
scored.method: share of non-cover cutscenes whose first_s is in the lower half of their band

scored.title: Hands back on the play camera
The child can poke, look or choose
scored.method: share with interaction in camera, poke, choice, rhythm

scored.title: One signal drives many world channels
scored.method: share whose signal drives >= signal_channels_min world channels

scored.title: Lands on the bar and ends on a sting
scored.method: share with music.bars set (or cover loop) and music.sting set

scored.title: Covers show the real work and never fake progress
scored.method: share of covers with cover.show in world_build, play, travel and fake_percent false (full points when there are no covers)

scored.title: Shorter the second time
scored.method: share of non-cover cutscenes with repeat_s < first_s or control_taken none

scored.title: Speaks its place's dialect
scored.method: share with dialect set and transition_in/out through the world (not cut or fade)

manual.title: A child watches it twice and wants a third
No game's footage, shot list, script, characters or music copied
